views.label: Static Walls
caption: The plane of $t$ and $y$ ($x_1 = x_2 = x_3 = 0$), each point a flat 3-space, a strip from $i^-$ to $i^+$ with one wall down its middle and the other on both edges.

views.label: Conformally Flat
caption: The plane of $t$ and $w$ ($x_1 = x_2 = x_3 = 0$), each point a flat 3-space, one copy of the interval from $i^-$ to $i^+$ between its two walls.

views.label: Static Bulk
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($x_1 = x_2 = x_3 = 0$), each point a flat 3-space, with the naked singularity $r = 0$ on the left and the cosmological horizon on the two right edges.

views.label: Rolling Walls
caption: The plane of $t$ and $y$ ($x_1 = x_2 = x_3 = 0$) of the moving walls, each point a flat 3-space, the upper half of the static strip with the singularity $t = t_0$ on its lower edge.
